title: Descemet Stripping Automated Endothelial Keratoplasty in Thick Corneas

indication: Corneal endothelial dysfunction: pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 21/30, Fuchs endothelial dystrophy 4/30, blunt ocular trauma 3/30, CHED 2/30 (Table 1); triple-DSAEK in 6/30; previous corneal transplantation, glaucoma drainage valve and active infection or inflammation excluded

groups.indication: baseline condition subgroup: preoperative corneal thickness at or below the cohort median (Group 1; split value stated in Results)
groups.description: Group 1: DSAEK with Moria ALTK-prepared lenticules (7-8 mm punch) inserted with a Busin glide, two corneal specialists, retrobulbar or general anesthesia; ofloxacin 1 month and prednisolone acetate 1%; triple-DSAEK in 3

groups.indication: baseline condition subgroup: preoperative corneal thickness above the cohort median (Group 2)
groups.description: Group 2: same DSAEK technique and aftercare; triple-DSAEK in 3

exclusions.reason: Recipient-only thickness; protocol uses the total central corneal thickness for DSAEK

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA and ECD blocks; Table 1 donor ECD
Results text values for eyes with and without bullous keratopathy (preoperative, 1 and 12 months)
exclusions.reason: Given in text only (no table cell) and grouped differently from the tabulated groups

notes: Retrospective study of 30 eyes of 30 patients (January 2017 to December 2018), two corneal surgeons; groups are split at the cohort median preoperative corneal thickness, a baseline patient condition, so both are control (group naming follows the median split; the endothelium dataset names the same groups by the stated value).
The groups are defined by the reference value itself (median split of preoperative thickness).

Table 1 labels the reference 'Preoperative corneal thickness' without 'central'; Methods: preoperative corneal thickness, recipient corneal thickness and graft thickness were assessed with AS-OCT (Carl Zeiss Meditec). The postoperative total is labelled 'Central cornea thickness'. Flagged for review.
Table 1 reference cells contain the literal text '(range)' after mean ± SD without range numbers; only the leading mean is read.
Triple-DSAEK (combined phacoemulsification and IOL) in 3 eyes per group; procedure context dsaek.
